origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: He kaitiaki wai e whakahaere ana i nga ngaru me nga awa whakaora, i tona kainga i te moana, engari ka mate i roto i nga whenua maroke.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Whakarewahia he kōne o te wai ki te aroaro, e mahi ana i te 4 kino me te akiaki i nga hoariri ki tawhiti. 5 hēkona whakawera.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Waihohia he ngaru whakaora e whakahoki mai ana i te 6 HP ki a koe me nga kaitakaro e tata ana.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Ko te wai
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Whakamahia te manawa i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: He nui ake te tere o te kaukau i te ritenga.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Whakahoutia te hauora i te wa e uru ana koe ki te wai.
Whakaorangia nga kino i roto i nga koraha me nga whenua pakaru te hau maroke e pakaru ana i to kaha.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: 25% iti iho te kino o te whawhai.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: He Makai ahi
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Ka maka e ia nga poipoi ahi, ka pupuhi ki roto ki te ahi, ka tahuna i te hunga e patu ana i a koe. E kore e taea e te ahi te kino ki a koe, engari ko te wai te whakangaro i a koe.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Pahupahu
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻoulu i kahi ʻāpana o nā pōkole ahi ʻepekema i ka ʻaoʻao āu e ʻike ai.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Ko te Whakarae o te Reinga
Whakatuwherahia he pupuhi o te ahi e pakaru ana i nga hoariri katoa e tata ana.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Ko te 30% o te kino e whakawhiwhia ana e nga kaiwhaiwhai hei utu mo te ahi.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: He ārai ki te ahi, ki te pā, ki te pānga o te pāmahana.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Tangohia te 1 kino i ia hēkona i roto i te wai, i te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: He Pūkahu o roto
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Ko te hiakai e 50% tere ake ana i te wera o roto.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Air Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Ko tētahi kaikawe rererangi tere e tuku ana i ngā utu hau, e huri ana i tētahi hau o te whakaraerae, e eke ana ki runga ki te rangi. He maama rite ki te hau, engari he ngoikore rite ki te rau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Whakarewahia he pupuhi hau e hanga ana i te pupuhi o te whakaheke i te pānga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: He hau hau
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pupuhi hau e puta ai tētahi hauhau i runga i te pānga ka kukume, ka whakaara, ka hurihia ngā tūnga e tata ana mō ngā hēkona e wha.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Te whakairi i runga
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Whakarewa koe ki te rangi i runga i te pou o te rangi.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Ka whakaiti te hau i to hinga kaore koe e raru i te hinga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Ko te Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Ka kawea e ngā hau ā-roto ā-roto ka neke atu i te 20% te tere ake i te hikoi.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Te takai o ngā ruuma
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Whakatika iho, me te mea e kore e kaha te kaha o te kaha o te taumaha.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: He anga whakangahau
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 ngā ngākau (-4 max HP). Kāore he tinana o te hau e hanga kia roa.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: He taumaha ngawari
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Whakaorangia te 50% atu o te whakaheke ka kawea koe e te hau kia ngawari.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Te Mage o te Taumaha
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: Ko tētahi kaikawe o ngā āpure taimaha e huri ana i te mokowā.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Ko te Wai Taumaha
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Whakatuhia he karapu pouri e pakaru ana ki roto ki te poka pango i te pānga. ka kukume nga tinana tata ki tona pokapū ka kino mo nga hēkona e wha.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Whakatuwherahia he ngaru pupuhi e pupuhi ana i nga mea katoa e tata ana.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Ko te whakahere i te rewera
Whakapaipai: whakaeke i te taimaha me te piki i runga i te whakahau (Levitation I).
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_no_fall_da: Kaore e taea e koe te tango i te kino o te hinga.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Kia 75% atu te whakaheke o te pūngao, ka ngāwari ake tō whakarewa.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: 25% iti iho te kino o te whawhai. Ko to kaha kei te hopu, ehara i te patu.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: He Mātakitaki i te Roto
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: He kaitohutohu i te atarangi e karanga ana ki nga karapu atarangi e huri ana i waenga i nga pounamu o te pouri.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Ko te Orb o te atarangi
Whakanohoia he karapu atarangi ki to waahi e whakawhiwhia ana ki te pouri me te matapo ki nga hoariri tata. E toru nga karapu e mahi ana i te wa ano.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Ko te Taahiraa o te atarangi
Teleport ki te wahi e rapu ana koe, tae atu ki te 24 tāone tawhiti. utu 2 mana, 4 hēkona cooldown.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Kia mārama te kite i te pōuri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Whakaaturanga Po (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Ko te Kaata o te atarangi
E kitea ana koe e ngā rōpū i te 40% anake o to rātau whānuitanga noa.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Tangohia te 1 kino i ia hēkona i te marama o te ra.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Ko taku 30% te puhoi ake te marama o nga mata e pa ana ki o kanohi.
